parameters.jsCode:
const classification = $json.taskClassification || {};
const route = $json.quotaRoute || {};
const files = classification.changedFiles || [];

const markdown = [
  "# TAJ Agent Mesh - Commit QA v0",
  "",
  `Repository: ${$json.repositoryFullName || "unknown"}`,
  `Branch: ${$json.branch || "unknown"}`,
  `Commit: ${$json.commitSha || "manual-test"}`,
  "",
  "## Classification",
  "",
  `Risk: ${classification.risk || "unknown"}`,
  `Domains: ${(classification.domains || []).join(", ") || "none"}`,
  "",
  "## Route",
  "",
  `Quota mode: ${route.quotaMode || "unknown"}`,
  `Primary agent: ${route.primaryAgent || "unknown"}`,
  `Primary model: ${route.primaryModel || "unknown"}`,
  `Allow auto edit: ${route.allowAutoEdit === true ? "yes" : "no"}`,
  `Requires human approval: ${route.requiresHumanApproval === true ? "yes" : "no"}`,
  "",
  "## Changed Files",
  "",
  ...files.map(file => `- ${file}`),
  "",
  "## v0 Policy",
  "",
  "Review-only output. No automatic edits, commits, merges, or deployments."
].join("\n");

return [
  {
    json: {
      ...$json,
      reviewMarkdown: markdown
    }
  }
];
